package org.apache.commons.lang3.function.primitives;

import java.util.function.IntSupplier;

/**
 * A functional interface like {@link IntSupplier}, but for a byte.
 *
 * @since 3.19
 */
@FunctionalInterface
public interface ByteSupplier {

    /**
     * Supplies a byte.
     *
     * @return a result.
     */
    byte getAsByte();
}
